notes: Minor + patch. 18.3 is intentionally 'identical to 18.2 but adds warnings for deprecated APIs' ahead of React 19; 18.3.1 only exports act from react. New console deprecation warnings appear but no runtime behavior breaks. Classic false-positive trap: the word 'deprecated' appears many times but nothing is removed.

evidence.text: 18.3.1 (April 26, 2024): Export act from react. 18.3.0 (April 25, 2024): This release is identical to 18.2 but adds warnings for deprecated APIs and other changes that are needed for React 19. It adds a warning for the deprecated findDOMNode outside StrictMode, a warning for deprecated test-utils methods, a warning for deprecated Legacy Context outside StrictMode, a warning for deprecated string refs outside StrictMode, a warning for deprecated defaultProps for function components, a warning when spreading key, a warning when using act from test-utils, a warning for deprecated unmountComponentAtNode, and a warning for deprecated renderToStaticNodeStream. These are warnings only; existing code continues to run.
